Associated with manuscript: Agreement between heuristic shrinkage factor and optimal shrinkage factors in logistic regression for risk prediction: a simulation study across different sample sizes and settings

# Plots for results from simulation study 1 (alternative DGM where $Q_{meas}$  and the C-statistic are independent - see section 4 of manuscript)

We present plots of $S_{VH}$ and $S_{boot}$ plotted against $S_{opt}$ from simulation study 1 for every combination of the simulation inputs, where the alternative data generating mechanism was used (see section 4 for more details).

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
counter <- 27
for (correlated in c(TRUE, FALSE)){
  for (xvar2 in c("S.VH", "S.boot")){
    for (type in c("mean", "median")){
      for (byvar in c("noapp", "app")){
        ### Define Figure captions
        if (xvar2 == "S.VH"){xvar.label <- "$S_{VH}$"}
        if (xvar2 == "S.boot"){xvar.label <- "$S_{boot}$"}
        if (correlated == TRUE){corr.label <- "non-zero covariance in DGM"}
        if (correlated == FALSE){corr.label <- "zero covariance in DGM"}
        if (byvar == "app"){byvar.label <- "presented with respect to apparent model performance"}
        if (byvar == "noapp"){byvar.label <- "presented with respect to population-level model performance"}
        if (byvar == "app"){byvar.fig.label <- "app."}
        if (byvar == "noapp"){byvar.fig.label <- NULL}
        cat("\n\n\n")
        cat("**Figure S", counter, ".A: alternative DGM (see section 4 of manuscript); ", type, "(", xvar.label, ") plotted against ", type, "($S_{opt}$), ", corr.label, ", ", byvar.label, "**", sep = "")
        cat(" \n\n")
        cat("*Estimator = ", type, "(", xvar.label, ")*", sep = "")
        cat(" \n\n")
        cat("*Covariance structure = ", corr.label, "*", sep = "")
        cat(" \n\n")
        cat("*By variable = ", byvar.label, "*", sep = "")
        cat(" \n\n")
        cat("![](",paste("../figures/ss3/ss3_gg.",
                         byvar.fig.label,
                         "corr", as.numeric(correlated), 
                         ".cat", 0,
                         ".", xvar2, 
                         ".", type, 
                         ".alpha", 0.25, ".png", sep = ""),")")
        
        cat(" \n\n")
        cat("-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------")
        counter <- counter + 1
      }
    }
  }
}

cat("\n\n\n")
cat("**Figure S", counter, ".A: mean($S_VH$) plotted against mean($S_{opt}$), grouped by mean($C_app$), non-zero covariance in DGM**", sep = "")
cat(" \n\n")
cat("![](",paste("../figures/ss3/ss3_gg.corr1.S.VH.mean.C.group.png"),")")
counter <- counter + 1

cat("\n\n\n")
cat("**Figure S", counter, ".A: mean($S_VH$) plotted against mean($S_{opt}$), grouped by $C_pop$, non-zero covariance in DGM**", sep = "")
cat(" \n\n")
cat("![](",paste("../figures/ss3/ss3_gg.corr1.S.VH.mean.C.pop.group.png"),")")
counter <- counter + 1

cat("\n\n\n")
cat("**Figure S", counter, ".A: mean($S_VH$) plotted against mean($S_{opt}$), grouped by mean($C_app$), zero covariance in DGM**", sep = "")
cat(" \n\n")
cat("![](",paste("../figures/ss3/ss3_gg.corr0.S.VH.mean.C.group.png"),")")
counter <- counter + 1

cat("\n\n\n")
cat("**Figure S", counter, ".A: mean($S_VH$) plotted against mean($S_{opt}$), grouped by $C_pop$, zero covariance in DGM**", sep = "")
cat(" \n\n")
cat("![](",paste("../figures/ss3/ss3_gg.corr0.S.VH.mean.C.pop.group.png"),")")
counter <- counter + 1   
```
